en.summary: Revenue grew 103.21% YoY, led by the Data Center platform. GAAP gross margin rose 1.4 percentage points YoY but fell 0.2 points QoQ; next-quarter guidance implies a lower midpoint. Cash conversion, inventories and multi-year commitments remain key follow-ups.
findings: GAAP gross margin was 74.8%, up 1.4 percentage points YoY and down 0.2 points QoQ. Each comparison uses a different baseline.

Operating cash flow was $48.253B; company-defined free cash flow was $43.777B, up 98.18% YoY. Operating cash flow was 73.91% of GAAP net income. Free cash flow deducts capital purchases and related principal repayments.

Days sales outstanding increased from 60 to 64 days, while inventory rose from $31.6B to $39.7B. Growing working-capital needs warrant monitoring collections and inventory turnover; these movements alone do not establish bad debts or weaker demand.

FY2027 Q4 revenue guidance is $126.1B–$133.9B and GAAP gross margin guidance is 71%–72%, with a midpoint 3.3 percentage points below this quarter. The next quarter has an extra week. Guidance assumes no China Data Center compute revenue.

Multi-year supply commitments rose from $279B to $390B. Maximum gross guarantee exposure is $118B. Procurement commitments and contingent guarantees have different timing and triggers; their sum does not measure current expense or immediately payable debt.
Revenue was $115.844B, up 103.21% YoY and 20.39% QoQ. Data Center represented approximately 92.88% of revenue.
